acceptanceCriteriaCoverage.description: Instruction Section: product-specific instructions from Salesforce, FATCA notice, 4 residency buttons
coveredBy: Instruction section loads with all four residency type buttons visible
Product-specific instructions are dynamically loaded from Salesforce
FATCA compliance notice is displayed with correct link

acceptanceCriteriaCoverage.description: On Button Click: clicking residency button shows documentation requirements table
coveredBy: ECCU Territories button reveals correct KYC identification requirements
CARICOM button reveals correct KYC identification and address requirements
Non-CARICOM button reveals two-ID and address proof requirements
Self-Employed button reveals residency-dependent ID count requirements

acceptanceCriteriaCoverage.description: Accordion behavior: collapsible, one section open at a time, auto-close when another opens
coveredBy: Opening a second accordion section auto-closes the first
Clicking the already-open accordion section collapses it
Rapid double-click on accordion button does not toggle section twice
Accordion residency type buttons are fully keyboard accessible
Screen reader announces accordion expanded and collapsed states

acceptanceCriteriaCoverage.description: Navigation: Continue → Personal Information, Save Progress, Back to Dashboard
coveredBy: Continue button navigates to the Personal Information section
Save Progress button persists the current state
Back to Dashboard button returns the customer to the main dashboard
Navigation buttons are keyboard accessible and reachable
Instruction section is readable on mobile viewport

missingCoverage.description: The ECCU KYC table notes that minors need parent/guardian KYC + birth certificate. No interactive scenario covers this — informational display only. Recommend manual verification.
The ticket does not specify the exact error message when Salesforce is unavailable. The negative scenario uses a placeholder message — confirm with product team.

When multiple products are selected, the ordering of instruction sections 3 and 4 was confirmed by Prachi Jangid (Comment #13). An explicit ordering test was not generated — the Scenario Outline covers content presence but not display order.

playwrightNotes: Accordion state verified via aria-expanded attribute
Salesforce API unavailability requires network interception (page.route) or test environment flag
FATCA link open-in-new-tab requires popup/new-tab handling in Playwright
Session expiry scenario requires manual token invalidation or clock mocking
Mobile viewport scenario requires viewport.set({ width: 375, height: 812 })
